verse.verse_1: I CALL TO witness the heavens and the night Star --
verse.verse_2: How will you comprehend what the night star is?
verse.verse_3: It is the star that shines with a piercing brightness --
verse.verse_4: That over each soul there is a guardian.
verse.verse_5: Let man consider what he was made of:
verse.verse_6: He was created of spurting water
verse.verse_7: Issuing from (the pelvis) between the backbone and the ribs.
verse.verse_8: God has certainly power to bring him back (from the dead).
verse.verse_9: The day all secrets are examined
verse.verse_10: He will have no strength or helper.
verse.verse_11: So I call to witness the rain-producing sky,
verse.verse_12: And the earth which opens up (with verdure),
verse.verse_13: That this (Qur'an) is a decisive word
verse.verse_15: They are hatching up a plot,
verse.verse_16: But I too am devising a plan.
verse.verse_17: So bear with unbelievers with patience, and give them respite for a while.
